content:
Before you install a third-party plugin, perform the following steps:
• Obtained the plugin conﬁguration and license ﬁles and uploaded them to an Amazon S3 bucket.
The bucket must be in the same AWS Region as domain.
• A third-party plugin is a type of custom plugin. Make sure that the domain meets the
prerequisites for custom plugins.

hierarchy.parent: Installing third-party plugins in Amazon OpenSearch Service
